description: Magyar Energetikai és Közmű-szabályozási Hivatal: gas datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Public Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Magyar Energetikai és Közmű-szabályozási Hivatal. Coverage: Magyar Energetikai és Közmű-szabályozási Hivatal. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about gas; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: A magyar földgázrendszer adatai; Földgázipari Társaságok adatai; Éves földgázmérleg; Havi földgázmérleg. Formats seen: XLSX, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-kozadatportal.
